subject: Operations
title: AI in Demand Forecasting
description: One-minute skill: AI in Demand Forecasting.

hook.text: A retailer's AI predicted a snowstorm would spike hot chocolate sales 3 days before the weather forecast confirmed it.

buildup.text: Traditional forecasting uses historical averages. AI processes hundreds of variables in real time for sharper results.

discovery.text: Machine learning models weigh weather, social media trends, economic data, and local events simultaneously.

twist.text: AI forecasts are probabilistic—they give ranges, not certainties. Managers must still decide how much risk to accept.

climax.text: Companies using AI forecasting report 20–50% reductions in forecast error compared to traditional methods.

punchline.text: AI sees patterns humans miss. Together, they forecast better.

quiz.question: How much can AI reduce forecast error?
